study.title: Sketch-Based Cognitive Scaffolding for Generative AI
study.subtitle: CHI 2027 research prototype

prompts.introduction: You will look at still images and describe the shot you see in your own words. After you write, an AI image will be generated from your text. You may then revise your description. There are no correct answers. Do not try to write a professional prompt.
prompts.t1: Look at the image. Describe the shot as naturally as possible.
prompts.direct_refine: Look at the generated image. Revise your description so it better matches the shot you intended.
prompts.sketch_refine: Use the generated image and the sketch to revise your description. Write in your own words.
prompts.transfer: This is a new image. Describe the shot, then revise after you see the generated result. There is no sketch.
prompts.generating: Generating an image from your description. Please wait.
prompts.view_image: This image was generated from your description. It is feedback, not a score.
